mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_pa_page (page_id, latest_revision_id, latest_revision_number, latest_created_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{pageId}, #{latestRevisionId}, #{latestRevisionNumber}, #{latestCreatedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE latest_revision_id = #{latestRevisionId}, latest_revision_number = #{latestRevisionNumber}, latest_created_at = #{latestCreatedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime}
